title: Phones Have No Signal
immediate: All players discard any 1 Battery (if held).
art_notes: Hand holding phone with x bars

title: You Were Being Watched
immediate: The player with the lowest Sanity loses 1 more Sanity.

title: A Fresh Delivery
immediate: Add 2 Food to the Resource Bag at Ellie & Luca's House.

title: The Neighborhood Is Too Quiet
immediate: No threats spawn at night tonight at house tiles.
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Charlie checks ignore the Basketball Court.
art_notes: Empty street with a single fallen toy

title: School Is Closed
immediate: Move all standees at the Basketball Court to an adjacent tile.

title: An Old Friend Calls
immediate: Choose one player. They gain +2 Sanity.
art_notes: Phone ringing in a dim kitchen

title: A Cool Breeze
immediate: Each player at a sport court loses 1 Hunger.
art_notes: Curtains lifting in an open window

title: A Rumor on the Street
immediate: Reveal the next Dawn card. Place it back on top.

title: A Stray Cat Arrives
immediate: A cat follows the player with the highest Sanity. That player gains +1 Sanity at Tick while the cat stays.
ongoing: Until next Dawn: the cat stays. If that player takes damage the cat flees.
art_notes: A scraggly cat sitting on a fence post at dusk

title: Someone Left a Bicycle
immediate: One player at a sport court may take the Bicycle token (free item: Move costs 0 Hunger).
art_notes: A rusted bicycle leaning against a chain-link fence

title: The Garden Still Grows
immediate: Add 1 Food to every house tile's resource area.
art_notes: Tomatoes ripening in an overgrown backyard plot

title: A Strange Radio Signal
immediate: All players roll d6. On a 6: gain a Clue card hint (peek at Market deck for Clue). On a 1: lose 1 Sanity.
art_notes: A crackling radio with green light in a dark room

title: An Old Photograph
immediate: Choose one player. They gain +1 Sanity and may peek at the top Threat card.
art_notes: A polaroid of five kids standing in front of a house
